flags_for_next_wave: ScatterVarietyDriver uses Resources.Load<Sprite>() which returns null for sprites outside a Resources/ folder; falls back to procedural magenta dot sprite at runtime in built game. PNGs must be in Assets/Resources/ for Resources.Load to resolve, or the driver needs to use a different loading strategy (AssetBundle, Addressables, or pre-wired SerializeField). At batchmode test scale the fallback dot doesn't break QA, but operator may see magenta decals in day-N build unless sprites are moved or a Resources/ redirect is configured.
Grow zone button ('경작 (P)') self-attaches to Canvas at runtime (bottom-center, x=+462, y=104). If operator prefers it in the GuiControlBar strip, a GuiControlBar.cs edit is required (future wave).

IsPlantableCell accepts any non-water/non-rock walkable ground — not restricted to a specific dirt tile. If RimWorld-strict soil gating is wanted, add DirtTile static ref to TilemapStaticRefInit (flagged, not done per lane A contract).
